messages.subject: Re: 使用ggplot繪圖
messages.body_plain:
Hi Eric,

參考以下程式碼與繪圖結果:

(1). 本例使用 facet_wrap 建立二個分面並繪製長條圖
(2). yintercept 刪除 aes 函數即可繪製2條水平線

###
library(ggplot2)
d_comm <- data.frame(area = rep(c("A", "B", "C", "D"), 2),
                     gender = gl(2, 4, labels = c("男", "女")),
                     freq = c(9, 10, 13, 4, 18, 7, 8, 11))
d_comm
#   area gender freq
# 1    A     男    9
# 2    B     男   10
# 3    C     男   13
# 4    D     男    4
# 5    A     女   18
# 6    B     女    7
# 7    C     女    8
# 8    D     女   11

p <- ggplot(data = d_comm,

            mapping = aes(x = area, y = freq, fill = area))
p + geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ gender) +
  theme(legend.position = "top" ,
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ,
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank() ,
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_brewer() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(10,15), colour = "#990000", linetype = "dashed")
###
